Increased rate of fire and recoil while you're holding down the trigger. Kills with this weapon reload a portion of the magazine.

Holding down the trigger grants a stack of 'Ride The Bull' every 0.833 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks are removed on trigger release.

Ride The Bull grants 10%|20% increased rate of fire and ?%|?% increased recoil at 1|2 stacks.

Kills instantly <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine.
